title: Wireframe/Lo-Fi
content: Apply wireframe/lo-fi prototype aesthetic with early design stage feel. Gray and white color scheme. Hand-drawn sketchy borders. Placeholder boxes with X patterns for images. Lorem ipsum or squiggle lines for text. Annotation callouts and arrows. Grid dots or lines visible. Include redline measurements. Sticky note elements. Work-in-progress, ideation atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create low-fidelity wireframe aesthetic with sketchy boxes, placeholder content, and prototype feel.
variants.detailed: Apply wireframe/lo-fi prototype aesthetic with early design stage feel. Gray and white color scheme. Hand-drawn sketchy borders. Placeholder boxes with X patterns for images. Lorem ipsum or squiggle lines for text. Annotation callouts and arrows. Grid dots or lines visible. Include redline measurements. Sticky note elements. Work-in-progress, ideation atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply wireframe/lo-fi prototype aesthetic with design thinking feel. Color palette: grayscale only - white (#ffffff), light gray (#f5f5f5), medium gray (#999999), dark gray (#333333), with occasional blue (#0066ff) for links/annotations. Sketchy borders: hand-drawn appearance using SVG filters (roughness) or slightly uneven border-radius, border-style could be dashed. Placeholder images: boxes with diagonal X pattern (CSS linear-gradient), or gray boxes with image icon. Text placeholders: actual lorem ipsum, or horizontal lines (squiggles) representing text blocks. Annotations: callout bubbles, numbered circles, arrows pointing to elements, measurement lines with dimensions. Grid system: visible dot grid or light line grid as background, snap-to-grid feeling. Redlines: measurement annotations showing spacing and dimensions in red (#ff0000). Sticky notes: yellow (#fff59d) squares with handwritten-style font, rotated slightly. Component labels: element names above/beside components (Header, Button, Card). Hand-drawn elements: slightly imperfect shapes, Balsamiq-style mockup feel. Cursor: can be crosshair suggesting design tool. Versions: corner version numbers (v1, v2). Comments: annotation comments from stakeholders. Interactive: click to add annotation feeling. Export marks: crop marks, safe area indicators. Implementation: SVG filters for sketch effect, CSS patterns for placeholders. Accessibility: wireframes should still be navigable, proper semantic structure despite sketch appearance.
